name: design-review
description: Review a design through independent lenses in parallel, score them, and stage a recommendation for a human. The judges cannot see each other's verdicts.

design.help: The design to review — a doc, a diff, a description, or a path to one.

criteria.default: Is it correct, safe to build, and usable by the people it is for?
criteria.help: What the judges should measure against.

steering_examples.description: Review docs/design/new-scheduler.md. Weight feasibility highest — we have three weeks.
Add a cost lens to the panel; this design triples our egress and nobody scored that.

lenses.name: correctness
lenses.prompt: Does it actually work? Look for cases the design does not handle, states it cannot represent, and assumptions it never checks.

lenses.name: feasibility
lenses.prompt: Can this be built as described, by the people who will build it, in the time implied? Name the part most likely to blow the estimate.

lenses.name: ux
lenses.prompt: What will using this feel like for the person it is for? Look for the step where they will get stuck and the error they will not understand.

config.prompt: The panel has reviewed and a recommendation is ready. Approve to accept it, or deny to send it back with your own notes.
